lines.text: Many learners say: My money are in the bag.
Better: My money is in the bag.
Money is one thing, so use is.
Is! The money is on the table.

data.wrong: My money are in the bag.
data.right: My money is in the bag.
data.why: Money is one thing, so use is.

native.tip: Русские «деньги» — множественное число, а английское “money” — единственное: “money is.”
